plugins.name: eval
plugins.description: GitHub Copilot Evals (Preview): set up a project with /eval setup, create and save evals with /eval create, save revised copies with /eval improve, run with /eval run, review with /eval review, and compare saved runs or explore one skill with /eval compare. Setup is optional; saves use normal host permissions and runs require cost/effect approval.
